description: Deletes an access control rule from a Google Calendar. Use when you need to remove sharing permissions for a user, group, or domain.

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

name: acl_delete

display_url.description: URL to view the resource in Google Calendar web UI. None for ACL delete operations as there is no direct URL for individual ACL rules.
display_url.title: Display Url

response_data.description: Optional convenience wrapper returned to indicate the outcome of the delete operation. Not part of the official Google Calendar HTTP response.
response_data.title: Response Data

status.description: Outcome of the delete operation. 'success' indicates the ACL rule was deleted successfully.
status.title: Status
